caveats: Current-constituent backtest: all three universes were selected in Nov 2026 with hindsight, so the 2020-2026 series carries survivorship and look-ahead bias by construction. Read it as 'how today's names travelled', not as an achievable track record.
Price return only (ordinary dividends unadjusted), equal weight, quarterly rebalance on the last trading day of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec — production methodology v4.0 mechanics.

Late listings (IPO / spin-off / relisting / de-SPAC after 2020-01-02) enter at the first quarterly rebalance on/after their sourced regular-way listing date (data/research/listing_dates.csv); when-issued, OTC and SPAC trust-shell prints never count.
Research source: Yahoo Finance EOD via yfinance (split-adjusted close). Not a licensed index-data feed; internal research view only, never a published index value (methodology §8 publication gate).

Universes are the v4.0 lists checked into this repo: AS-100 from large_cap_100.csv (2026-11-09 construction) and AS-MCG100 / AS-MCB100 from mixed_cap_universe.csv (2026-11-13 screen built from You.com discovery and Yahoo caps). Cap bands are today's, not 2020's, so names that grew into a band are backtested inside it.
Benchmarks are ETF price proxies rebased to 1000 on the same base date; licensed index values are never fetched.

Corporate events (splits, spin-offs, ticker changes, de-SPAC listings, pending deals) were researched per constituent with the You.com Search API and curated with sources in data/research/corporate_events.csv; every split / spin-off is verified to be adjusted in the price frame on its effective date.
caveats_zh: 本回测采用当前成分股：三个宇宙均于 2026 年 11 月在已知结果的情况下选出，因此 2020–2026 年序列天然带有幸存者偏差和前视偏差。请将其理解为“当前这批股票的历史走势”，而非可实现的业绩记录。
仅计价格收益（普通股息不调整），等权重，于每年 3/6/9/12 月最后一个交易日季度再平衡，沿用生产方法论 v4.0 的计算机制。
2020-01-02 之后上市的公司（IPO、分拆、重新上市、SPAC 合并）在其有据可查的正式上市日之后的首个季度再平衡日纳入（见 data/research/listing_dates.csv）；when-issued、场外（OTC）及 SPAC 空壳期报价一律不计。
研究数据来源：经 yfinance 获取的 Yahoo Finance 日终数据（经拆股调整的收盘价）。并非授权指数数据，仅供内部研究，绝不作为对外发布的指数值（方法论第 8 节发布门槛）。
宇宙为仓库中的 v4.0 名单：AS-100 取自 large_cap_100.csv（2026-11-09 构建），AS-MCG100 / AS-MCB100 取自 mixed_cap_universe.csv（2026-11-13 筛选，基于 You.com 检索与 Yahoo 市值）。市值区间按当前而非 2020 年划分，因此后来才进入该区间的股票也按该区间回测。
基准为 ETF 价格代理，于同一基期重设为 1000；从不获取授权指数数值。
公司行动（拆股、分拆、代码变更、SPAC 合并上市、待完成交易）已用 You.com 搜索 API 逐只研究，并附来源整理于 data/research/corporate_events.csv；每次拆股/分拆均核实已在价格数据中于生效日完成调整。
